title: The Smuggler's Toll
logline: An indebted smuggler needs help guiding a refugee ship past their own boss's dark zone toll booth without paying the exorbitant fees.

roles.description: Sweating, nervous, trying to do one good thing in their life.
Cruel, demands absolute loyalty and a cut of everything.
A hidden listening post masking a safe route through the dark zone.
An unarmed transport packed with people, running on fumes.
The ruthless organization controlling the dark zone routes.

public_situation: The {role:smuggler_cartel} has locked down the only safe route through the dark zone, charging massive tolls to fleeing refugee ships.
private_truth: The indebted smuggler is secretly escorting a refugee ship for free because they remind them of their own lost family. The boss suspects betrayal.

beats.public_change: The smuggler gunship begins actively scanning all passing traffic.

missions.reason: The smuggler asks the pilot to deliver a fake sensor manifest to the relay to mask the refugee ship's approach.
missions.private_fact: The boss's sensors see through the fake manifest immediately.

beats.public_change: The boss orders the indebted smuggler to power down and prepare for boarding.

missions.reason: The boss hires the pilot to meet the indebted smuggler at the relay dock and collect the toll by force.
missions.private_fact: The indebted smuggler begs the pilot not to take the toll, as it is the refugees' entire life savings.

beats.public_change: The indebted smuggler panics and tries to run the blockade.

missions.reason: The indebted smuggler begs the pilot to attack the boss's gunship to clear a path for the refugee ship's escape.
missions.private_fact: The gunship captain hails the pilot mid-fight, offering a cut of the cartel's future tolls if they turn and destroy the indebted smuggler instead.

resolutions.summary: The indebted smuggler and the refugee ship escape into the dark zone safely. The boss is furious and marks the pilot for death.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped a smuggler grow a conscience and save a refugee ship.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the gunship captain's offer.
resolutions.summary: The indebted smuggler is killed, and the refugee ship is captured. The pilot becomes a favored asset of the cartel.
The boss easily catches the fleeing refugee ship. The indebted smuggler is imprisoned, and the refugees are sold into labor camps.

loose_threads.detail: The cartel gunship's hull plating has recent, high-end commercial transit registry numbers filed off.
The indebted smuggler carries an empty, military-grade stasis pod powered on in their cargo hold.

radio_hooks: Rumors of extortion on the dark zone routes.

voice_direction.smuggler_boss: Deep, resonant, never raises their voice.
